entry.title: New: Bill 213 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 4, SECTION 24-17 AND SECTION 24-19, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO AN EXEMPTION FROM CERTAIN MOTOR VEHICLE TAXES AND FEES

Allows an exemption from certain motor vehicle taxes and fees for motor vehicles owned or leased for 12 months or longer by the County and for motor vehicles owned or leased for 12 months or longer by police officers who use their vehicles in the performance of their duties.

Latest action: Council: Bill 213 passes second & final reading - 10/16/2024
